description: The figure presents three pie charts comparing the distribution of four categories (N+K+, N−K+, N−K−, N+K−) for the “Zero-Shot” setting across three difficulty levels labeled easy, medium, and hard, with a total of 4 slices in each pie. In the easy chart, the teal N+K+ slice is labeled 55.4%, the yellow N−K+ slice is 38.3%, the orange N−K− slice is 4.6%, and the red N+K− slice is 1.7%. In the medium chart, the teal N+K+ slice is 58.8%, the yellow N−K+ slice is 35.4%, the orange N−K− slice is 4.0%, and the red N+K− slice is 1.8%. In the hard chart, the orange N−K− slice is 37.9%, the yellow N−K+ slice is 37.3%, the red N+K− slice is 6.7%, and the teal N+K+ slice appears as the remaining portion (approximately 18.1%), with a gray rectangular overlay partially obscuring part of the teal region. A legend on the right maps colors to labels, and percentage values are printed inside the slices; no slices appear exploded, and the slice ordering varies by chart rather than following a consistent descending arrangement.
